This climatic region can be subdivided into following three types of sub regions: Sub Humid,
SemiAridandArid.
Sub Humid: Sub Humid region is represented by Sialkot, Gujrat and Potwar area.This region
has hot summers and mild winters. Annual rainfallin this area ranges between 500-1000mm.
Semi Arid: Semi Arid region has hot summers and mild winters and is represented by Sahiwal,
Faisalabad, Lahore, Sheikupura, Peshawar and Bannu etc. Annual rainfall in this area ranges
between250-500mm.
Arid: Arid climate has hot summers and mild winters. The areas included in this region are
middle and upper Sindh, South West Punjab, Cholistan and Dera Gazi khan. This region
receiveslessthan250mmofrainfallannually.
